reviews.text:
Took my puppy here for a consultation. The vet I saw Natasha was very informative and gave me all information I needed as a first time dog owner. The ladies at reception were also very lovely and gave us a welcome package with goodies.
I also have had a phone consultation with her regarding my puppy’s car anxiety and she talked me through all the options.

Excellent service from every single member of the team. You can tell they truly love animals.
The vet we saw (Natasha?) was exceptional, she did a thorough check on my senior dog that has been with a lingering cough for a few months, she couldn’t have explained everything better.
About the actual premises I loved the whole look of it! Apart from how well equipped it is, and the fact that it’s open on Sundays, for some reason my dogs like to get sick on the weekends.
Their app looks easy to use and very convenient. I still need some time to use its features as I’m a new customer.
And last but not least I’m so so glad they offer a ln affordable membership with unlimited consults. It can get so costly with senior dogs, specially if they have chronic illnesses.

We've already visited the newly opened Creature Comforts twice with our dog, Watson, and have been so impressed!

From the moment you walk through the door, you are made to feel incredibly welcome. The vets and staff are absolutely lovely, friendly, caring, and genuinely interested in making the experience as positive as possible for both pets and their owners.

They've created such a calm and relaxing environment, which makes a huge difference, especially for Watson, who isn't normally a fan of trips to the vets! However, she seemed perfectly happy here, helped along by the many delicious treats she happily scoffed during our visits!  She even came home with a little party bag full of goodies, which she's thoroughly enjoying.

It's wonderful to have such a welcoming veterinary practice in Blackheath. We're delighted to have found them and wouldn't hesitate to recommend them. Thank you to the whole team for making Watson feel so comfortable and cared for!
Lovely staff, so patient with my girl thank you

Absolutely brilliant experience for my first visit to creature comforts! 5 star service all round. Anita waa super helpful and knwoledgable and gave my dogs a thorough check over, making  them feel very at ease! I felt she really cared about their wellbeing and took her time with their consultations. Credit to all the team who were friendly, helpful and welcoming. Creature comforts Blackheath is by far the best vet experience i've ever had! My dogs are looking forward to their next visit and they particularly enjoyed their treat bags! Thank you for a fabulous positice experience. Emma, Cali, Skittles and Amber

It's a beautiful, calm and very well located space. The team here are lovely - so friendly, welcoming and understanding. With an anxious dog, the frequent pet visits which are included in the monthly membership fee are fantastic and such good value for money. Also the treat wall is a definite hit and my dog loves it here. Highly recommend and it's a great addition to Blackheath Village.

Amazing staff, super friendly and knowledgeable, willing to listen and support. Amazing facilities, my puppy absolutely loved it in there, she received so much love and attention, she didn’t want to leave !!!

Absolutely obssessed!! I took my dog and cat in for the first time and the nurse was so so kind and attentive and made us all feel at ease. The clinic itself is just absolutely beautiful. Its spacious with a wall of treats and a coffee machine. It was such a positive experience for us all as my dog can be a bit difficult at times but she did so well here! The staff are so so lovely and Im glad we've found Creature Comforts! 🥰
Beautiful environment, friendly staff. Spotless. Made me and my pup feel at ease. A lovely approach to vet care. Gentle and kind   Definitely worth a look if you have a pet.

My cocker spaniel has been fearful of her vet after negative experiences. At our first appointment at Creature Comforts they immediately put her at ease, calmed her, played with her hence she was even happy to receive an injection from the vet without anxiety. Treatment was excellent throughout. Professional, compassionate and caring service. I would highly recommend Creature Comforts!
Finally, we found a vet that did a thorough examination of my dog and explained everything in detail. If I could I would give 10 stars. Thank you Blackheath creature comforts x

The best vet experience we've ever had.....walking into a luxurious waiting room and the dogs greeted by friendly staff with treats and toys instantly made the experience special and less intimidating for my dogs Biujee and Muifa.
Personalised vet service so you always see the same person making it feel more acquainted.....Natasha has been amazing with my two! None of us ever look forward to going to the vet.....but this place makes it come close. Thankyou 😁🙏🏼

Went to Creature Comforts for the first time on the 6/10 and first impressions was excellent. The reception area was light and airy and resembled a spa retreat, not a vets. The waiting area was nice and comfortable with comfortable seating, not the usual plastic chairs. There was even wireless phone charges. The reception staff was friendly as were the vet that saw me and Oscar. Overall I was very pleased, and this  will definately be my regular vets from now on.
Very impressed, calm , lovely atmosphere. Staff attentive and felt valued and cared for. Would recommend in a heartbeat
Such lovely kind friendly staff. I have a dog who’s usually terrified of going to the vets but he was so well looked after by Beth and put at ease making the whole experience a happy one thank you.

Great first visit at a Creature Comforts vet and we are super happy. Lovely modern clinic which has a relaxed atmosphere and is a big change from vets we have been to before! Some freebies in the waiting area, which is also separated slightly for cats and dogs. The staff are super helpful and sweet and made us feel welcomed. I feel that my concerns and opinions were heard and felt very in control in terms of the decisions made about my cat and his treatment. For once, we are not dreading his next vet visit knowing he is in good hands and in a calm environment!

Amazing!

As a previous customer of Medivet (awful service and opaque pricing), this was night and day in every way!

The staff were incredibly friendly and at no point did I feel rushed or as though I was a burden.

Beth was our vet, who was very lovely and gentle with our cat, Luna. It is the best I've seen our cat react at the vets, and the entire consultation was informative, friendly and as stress-free for Luna as possible.

Honesty, transparency and friendliness seem to be the values they work by. It was refreshing to see a company that does actually act like they care for the animals and not just their profits.

Lovely and comfortable waiting area, little treats and toys handed out, water offered whilst you wait.

5 stars easily. No regrets. Thank you to all of the staff there!

After bringing my 2 cats here on Monday for an initial check-up, I can honestly say they're the best vets I have found in the UK. The vets are amazing and all the staff are so welcoming. My cats felt very very safe and loved exploring the examination room. Highly recommend this vet. Xxx
A wonderful first visit! Such a warm, family atmosphere and everyone did their best to make my dog feel comfortable and relaxed. Very professional and caring — highly recommend!
First visit. Very impressed by decor etc but much more so by the warm welcome, thoroughness and efficiency.

We had a great initial checkup for our 2 cats with Natasha, she made them feel calm and talked us through all of our concerns! The waiting area is also a really nice and spacious, and the rest of the staff were lovely too

Our cats had their first visit today with Beth she was absolutely brilliant. She took attention to detail with our cats and explained step by step what she was doing. Thank you for an amazing visit and the staff were out of this world made you feel very welcoming and friendly. Forget the cats coming to visit I'll be doing more visits then the cats haha.
Beth, Tilly, robin and Charlotte was absolutely amazing, one of the best vets we’ve ever been too!
